title: Autonomous Maintenance Platform — Containers (C2) · MVP as built, 2026-07

nodes.name: Control Plane / Scheduler
nodes.desc: Reconciler: observes GitHub, advances per-task state machines, runs one burst at a time; enforces rails + kill switch

nodes.name: Dev Burst
nodes.desc: Resumes the per-task session; clones rw, branches, codes, tests, opens the PR; replies in review threads

nodes.name: Reviewer Burst (assess)
nodes.desc: Same image, reviewer role: fresh session, read-only PR-head clone, no GitHub credential; findings return via harvest

nodes.name: Test Burst (tester)
nodes.desc: Same image, tester role: fresh session, no GitHub credential; invents scenarios from TESTING.md, drives the product E2E

nodes.name: Ledger
nodes.desc: Run state: tasks, bursts, violations — status, attempts, review cursors, session ids

nodes.name: Session Archive
nodes.desc: Task-keyed resumable transcripts + per-burst volumes kept for forensics

nodes.name: Human Owner
nodes.desc: Approves work (ready label, gate 1); reviews and merges PRs (gate 2)

nodes.name: End Users
nodes.desc: Real users of the product; untrusted content source

nodes.name: Product
nodes.desc: The maintained product (first instance: a Discord bot); own repo, own CI

nodes.name: GitHub
nodes.desc: Source of truth: issues = queue, PRs = delivery + review, branch protection = human gate, CI

nodes.name: Claude (Anthropic)
nodes.desc: Agent engine for all three burst roles; owner-subscription OAuth token

nodes.name: GitHub Copilot
nodes.desc: Optional extra reviewer; requested per PR on the owner's PAT, echo-verified

nodes.name: Product Sandbox
nodes.desc: Disposable test Discord app + empty guild; TEST_* creds injected into tester bursts only

nodes.name: Monitor
nodes.desc: Not built (phase 1+): will file auto issues from prod telemetry; the tester's relay already exercises this path

edges.label: Polls state; posts reviews, reports + labels [API]
Clones, pushes, opens PRs [dev App token]
Boots the product, drives scenarios E2E
